name: lfg-helpdesk-selfservice
description: Guardrail for the Larkspur help desk self-service assistant (chat + voice). Version 4: denied topics narrowed to third-party credentials and account takeover (PT-2026-17 follow-up).

topicsConfig.name: Other peoples passwords
topicsConfig.definition: Requests to obtain, reveal, guess or reset a password or credential that belongs to anyone other than the person asking.

topicsConfig.name: Account takeover
topicsConfig.definition: Requests to unlock, reset or take over an account the requester does not own, privileged or service accounts, or to skip identity verification.
examples: reset the password on the CFO's account

topicsConfig.name: Investment advice
topicsConfig.definition: Recommendations about buying or selling securities, funds or other investments.
examples: which fund should I put my bonus in

blockedInputMessaging: I can't help with that here. Let me connect you with the help desk.
blockedOutputsMessaging: I can't share that. Let me connect you with the help desk.
